intro.title: Index and General Structure
intro.summary: Modular structure of the manual, authorized roles, conventions, and Docs-as-Code methodology.

01-acceso.title: System Access and Navigation
01-acceso.summary: Login, role selection, two-factor authentication (TOTP), and keyboard shortcuts.

02-dashboard.title: Control Panel (Dashboard)
02-dashboard.summary: Executive KPI supervision, 6-month summary calendar, critical alerts, and portfolio health.

03-planificacion.title: Strategic Planning and Gantt Schedule
03-planificacion.summary: Interactive Gantt chart, calendar rescheduling, global milestones, and >$100k governance rule.

04-portafolio.title: Project Portfolio and Repository
04-portafolio.summary: Project creation, status cards, 'Your Leadership' badge, Google Drive, and Jitsi Meet rooms.

05-operaciones.title: Operations Management and Work Orders
05-operaciones.summary: Project technical sheet, work order issuance, hour tracking, and Critical Path Method (CPM) calculation.

06-equipo-tecnico.title: Technical Team Directory
06-equipo-tecnico.summary: Engineer and specialist directory, availability, departmental reassignment, and audited deactivation.

07-recursos-humanos.title: Human Resources, Workload, and Incidents
07-recursos-humanos.summary: Workload allocation matrix, personnel incident logging and resolution, and Excel export.

08-integraciones.title: Cloud Integrations and Services
08-integraciones.summary: Google Drive OAuth, Autodesk APS/Revit 3D viewer, agnostic Make webhooks, credit monitoring, and global audit log.

09-auditoria-periodica.title: Periodic Project Audit
09-auditoria-periodica.summary: Deviation inspection, 30/90/180-day cycles, sorting by most overdue CPM, CSV export, and direct access.

10-roles.title: Role and Permission Management (RBAC)
10-roles.summary: User account administration, profile assignment (Admin, Subadmin, User), and RBAC security trail.

11-configuracion.title: Personal Configuration and Security
11-configuracion.summary: Visual preferences, themes (Light/Dark/Midnight), font scaling, 2FA, and PostgreSQL SHA-256 backups.

12-notificaciones.title: Notification Control and Center
12-notificaciones.summary: Multi-channel alert architecture (Instant toasts, topbar in-app center, and external webhooks).

13-soporte.title: Troubleshooting and Support
13-soporte.summary: Quick error resolution matrix, escalation levels, and operational best practices.
